lc_person: Anne Berg, born 1981, historian of education and social history; Uppsala history PhD (2011), later senior lecturer in history at the University of Gothenburg.
item_person: Anne Berg (also Anne Berg Larssen), handball player, born 1959.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is Berg, Anne, 1981-. The source note for Det mångsidiga verktyget (2009), p. 209, identifies Anne Berg as born in 1981 and a history PhD candidate at Uppsala University.
Q16382777 describes Anne Berg as a handball player, gives birth year 1959, and includes the name form Anne Berg Larssen. It nevertheless carries P244 n2010051692.
The supplied ORCID identifies its holder as Anne Berg.

The supplied ORCID records history doctoral study at Uppsala University from 2006 to 2011, later employment in historical studies at the University of Gothenburg, and the 2011 book Kampen om befolkningen. This agrees with the LC history PhD candidate in 2009.

The publisher identifies Anne Berg as born in 1981, docent and senior lecturer in history at the University of Gothenburg, with a 2011 dissertation on the development of Swedish nation formation through 1860.

notes: P244 n2010051692 is attached to the handball-player item in error. The supported birth year is for the LC historian. No replacement Wikidata QID was verified.
